statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
The service billed is cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271)
The diagnosis codes are I49.9, I34.0, and Z86.73
The claim was denied under reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific procedure is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
Cardiac event monitoring is medically necessary to capture rhythm data during symptomatic episodes
